rachats.citation: Aflac Incorporated (NYSE: AFL) announced today that it has completed its acquisition of Florida-based Argus Holdings, LLC and its subsidiary Argus Dental & Vision, Inc.

rachats.nom: Zurich North America Group Benefits business
rachats.citation: Aflac Incorporated (NYSE: AFL) announced today that its insurance subsidiaries American Family Life Assurance Company of Columbus (Aflac of Columbus) and American Family Life Assurance Company of New York (Aflac of New York) have completed the acquisition of Zurich North America's U.S. Corporate Life and Pensions (Group Benefits) business
